tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: lodge-blue
tokens.usage: Brotherhood, loyalty, ceremonial authority. Used as text on `.emblem-icon::before`, `.page-title h2`, `.stat-value`. 10.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ceremonial-gold
tokens.usage: Tradition, achievement, honor. Used as text on `.page-title h2::first-letter`, `.page-title::after`, `.section-header::before`; border on `.degree-level:hover`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: royal-purple
tokens.usage: High degrees, special recognition, honors. Used as border on `.degree-level.master`; text on `.scholar-amount`. 6.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: nav-link-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.emblem-icon`, `.category-tag`; background on `.nav-link:hover`, `.grand-session-banner::before`, `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
